Position Title: Software Design Co-op, Nuclear 

Department: Electrical Engineering 

Location: Cambridge, ON

Compensation: $25- $30

Get To Know Us

Reporting to the Electrical Engineering Manager, the Software Design Co-op, Nuclear will contribute to machine concepts, design of control software, integration of software with electrical and mechanical systems, process development, and machine installation at customer sites worldwide. The incumbent will also work on programming and integration assignments utilizing PLCs, PCs, robotics, motion controllers, vision systems, lasers, and other controllers while delivering the Eclipse Vision and the Eclipse Entrepreneurial Culture.

What You’ll Be Doing



-  Assist in the design and develop software programs (PLC and/or PC based) specific to customer and project requirements based on standard Eclipse programming methods
-  Assist in debug and commissioning control systems at Eclipse facilities during the system integration stage and then at the customer site during installation
-  Select, test, and integrate hardware and software components such as robots, analog devices, motion controllers, sensors, vision systems, and lasers
-  Work with other members of the Controls Engineering department and other groups to continuously improve methods of integrating controls technology, with the goals being enhanced safety, enhanced functionality, and reduced cost
-  Assist in providing thorough testing of machine functionality to verify software program completeness
-  Provide accurate documentation for each project
-  Advise customer on solving technical problems
-  Provide customer with training specific to their current project (i.e. machine operation, programming principles, and program structure)
-  Work requires professional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
-  Ability to work within a team environment and actively participate in group meetings
-  Complete other duties and projects as assigned
-  Ensure scheduled milestones are met
-  Notify the appropriate departments if milestones are not projected to be met by expected due dates
-  Adhere to the Eclipse Project Operating Policy
-  Maintain good corporate citizen role in support of the Eclipse Corporate Vision
-  Ensure that all business activities are performed with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with the Eclipse Automation Inc. Conduct Code
-  Adhere to all health and safety rules and procedures
-  Foster the development of a culture reflective of the core values of the business

What We’re Looking For



-  Currently enrolled in a post-secondary engineering degree, diploma or equivalent, specializing in mechanical, electrical, systems
-  Strong organizational skills
-  Ability to establish priorities and work with minimal supervision
-  Advanced computer skills in Excel
-  Team player and able to coordinate activities with other departments
-  Excellent written and oral communication skills
-  Students should be enrolled in a post-secondary academic program requiring a co-op/work term

Why Join Us

Here at Eclipse Automation, creation and innovation are at our core, and our culture reflects that. Fast-paced and continuously fostering growth, we encourage the entrepreneurial spirit that our teams embody, and leverage each of their strengths to do better for our people, our clients, and our communities. Our teams are made up of innovators, thinkers, and doers, with the know-how and expertise to exceed expectations, and the relentless spirit to create and reinvent. Our people are what enable us to live up to our name - to eclipse all others, inspiring and creating outcomes that change the world.

Eclipse Automation is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive work environment. It is our policy to recruit and select applicants solely on the basis of their qualifications. We are an equal opportunity employer that hires talent regardless of age, race, creed, colour, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or any other status or condition protected by applicable law. At Eclipse Automation, we believe in the power of human connection. We do not use AI in our hiring process; every application is personally reviewed by a member of our team to ensure each candidate receives careful consideration.

This publicly advertised job posting is for an existing vacancy. We are seeking a qualified candidate to join our team and assume the responsibilities of this role.

Eclipse Automation encourages applications from all qualified candidates. Those in need of accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process should notify eca_hresources@eclipseautomation.com. Any information received that relates to accommodation needs of a candidate will be addressed in a confidential manner.

Job Title: Software Developer Co-op

Location: Cambridge, ON | On-site

Job Type: Full-time

Compensation: $27.00 - $29.00 / hr

Get To Know Us

Eclipse Automation delivers cutting-edge custom automated manufacturing solutions across multiple industries. We combine advanced automation expertise with digital innovation to create smart, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing systems. Our global network includes facilities in Canada, the United States, and Hungary ensuring regional expertise and global strength.

The Position

The Software Developer Co-op will support the development of our cutting-edge Omniverse extensions, connectors, and applications. The incumbent will work with advanced technology in the areas of digital twins, AI, and custom automation, contributing to the digital transformation of manufacturing processes. The Software Developer Co-op will work with internal stakeholders to deliver the Eclipse Vision and the Eclipse Entrepreneurial Culture.

What You’ll Be Doing



- Learn and use Azure DevOps to provide feedback on tasks, create bug reports, track progress and communicate with the development team
- Participate in daily sprint sessions, providing input and feedback, and addressing clarifying questions from developers.
- Aid in the designing, building, and maintaining of Omniverse extensions and surrounding infrastructure using Python, C++, and USD.
- Conduct basic troubleshooting and testing of Omniverse extensions and connectors
- Work requires professional written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work in a team environment and actively participate in group meetings safely
- Work requires willingness to work a flexible schedule including weekends and or travel as required in varying timelines
- Ensure scheduled milestones are met and notify appropriate departments if milestones are not met
- Adhere to the Eclipse Project Operating Policy
- Maintain good corporate citizen role in support of the Eclipse corporate Vision
- Ensure that all business activities are performed with the highest ethical standards and in compliance with the Eclipse Automation Inc. Conduct Code
- Foster the development of a culture reflective of the core values of the business

What We’re Looking For



- Successful enrolment in a post-secondary degree/diploma, preferably in the Computer Science, Engineering or related program.
- Familiarity with Python and/or C++, knowledge of OpenUSD & NVIDIA Omniverse is a plus.
- Familiarity with DCC Software, CAD, and/or spatial computing
- Familiarity with or willingness to learn Azure DevOps and Git for development pipelines, task management and bug tracking.
- Ability to work within a fast-paced environment, and proven ability to multitask
- Team player and able to coordinate activities with other departments
- Take pride in your work and hold high standards when it comes to building software and user interfaces.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills.
- Students should be enrolled in a post-secondary academic program requiring a co-op/work term.

What We Offer



- Hands-on experience working for one of the largest and fastest growing automation companies on the globe
- Access to Eclipse’s network of industry professionals who will support and coach you
- Variety - our Co-ops love that every day is different
- Opportunities to work on projects for highly recognized brands
- Opportunity to own your work and have meaningful impact on the project.
- Free snacks
- Fun events and celebrations throughout the year
- Potential full-time work after you graduate
